summary: CASI Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K with its first half 2026 business and financial results. The press release covers routine operational updates: clinical trial progress for CID-103, a $15 million convertible note financing from ETP Global III Fund LP, a settlement agreement with Acrotech Biopharma rescinding termination of the EVOMELA license, an arbitration award, and financial results. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is announced. The filing is a standard periodic update by a foreign private issuer, with no board recommendation or deal terms. What to watch: continued clinical development and product transition from EVOMELA to MAFALAN.
